GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Passing the 200m was inconvenienced. When qst re her riding and why the horse settled back, rdr std instructed to settle the horse, which has a tendency to overrace, where comfortable, anticipating this would be near midfield. Std after being slow to begin, the gelding initially settled back in the field. She said that near the 1600m she became concerned that the horse was too far out of its ground which prompted her to shift out and improve her pos. Added, however, that her mnt was left racing wide and without cover for the remainder of the event.

Hampered @ start. Not pushed early & raced fiercely Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (4L from lead). Worked to improve 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 550m. Pushed along Five Wide @ 400m & pressured (3L from lead) on home turn. Worked to challenge leaders @ 200m & no match for winner in last 100m. # WIde/tried hard

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stewards interviewed rdr, the Starter and the barrier attendant assisting his mnt into the circumstances which caused the gelding to miss the start. It was EST that after being loaded, the gelding became fractious which resulted in barrier attendant adopt an accepted practice of turning its head to the side to have it settle. It was EST that as the start was effected there was a slight delay in the horse being released by the barrier attendant which caused the horse to stand flat footed and miss the start. No further action was taken.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m was eased and shifted out for clear running. Rdr said he was instructed to settle in the first four but, after beginning only fairly, settled worse than midfield before improving to race outside the leader near the 1600m when the tempo eased. He said the horse travelled comfortably but failed to finish off and did not feel comfortable in its action.  A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding had lost its near-hind plate and was showing heat stress. Vet certificate since received.
